author: golden state today
title: California men's tennis falls to Duke in ACC opener
text:
The California Golden Bears men’s tennis team opened their 2026 Atlantic Coast Conference season with a 4-2 loss to the Duke Blue Devils in Durham, North Carolina, on Friday. The defeat moves Cal to a 7-5 record, while Duke improves to 6-5.
Cal started strong in doubles play. Fryderyk Lechno Wasiutynski and Paris Pouatcha secured a 6-3 win on court three. Timofey Stepanov and Alex Aney then clinched the doubles point for the Bears with a victory on court two, giving Cal an early 1-0 lead heading into singles matches.
In singles competition, Bernardo Munk Mesa earned Cal’s only singles win with a 6-4, 6-2 result on court four. However, the Bears dropped matches on courts one, two, three, and five. The match between Pouatcha and Jayaraman was unfinished at 7-5, 4-4.
Singles results included Rodenas defeating Lechno Wasiutynski (5-7, 5-7), Williams defeating Stepanov (4-6, 2-6), Planelles Ripoll defeating Silva (4-6, 4-6), Munk Mesa defeating Visser (6-4, 6-2), and Long defeating Luemkemann (3-6, 3-6).
In doubles play: Williams/Rodenas defeated Silva/Luemkemann (2-6); Stepanov/Aney defeated Planelles Ripoll/Long (6-3); Lechno Wasiutynski/Pouatcha defeated Truwit/Visser (6-3).
The order of completion for singles was courts five, two, four, three and one; for doubles it was courts one, three and two.
Next up for the Golden Bears is a match against the North Carolina Tar Heels in Chapel Hill on Sunday at 9 a.m.
